state.seed_assertion: Data controllers are required to carry out a DPIA before any processing that is likely to result in a high risk to the rights and freedoms of individuals.

sentences.1: Data controllers are required to carry out a DPIA before any processing that is likely to result in a high risk to the rights and freedoms of individuals.
sentences.10: In some cases we may advise you not to carry out the processing because we consider it would be in breach of the GDPR.
sentences.2: Data controllers need to carry out a DPIA before any processing likely to result in a high risk to the rights and freedoms of individuals.
sentences.3: If you have determined that the processing is likely to result in a high risk to the rights and freedoms of data subjects, you must carry out a data protection impact assessment (DPIA) for each processing operation.
sentences.4: A data protection impact assessment is required when processing is likely to result in a high risk to the rights and freedoms of data subjects.
sentences.5: Organizations should consult individuals and other relevant stakeholders when carrying out a DPIA.
sentences.6: Carrying out a DPIA is not a one-time exercise.
sentences.7: A DPIA may also be carried out on a voluntary basis in order to identify and deal as effectively as possible with the risks, even if they are minor, to the rights and freedoms of individuals.
sentences.8: A controller shall carry out a review to assess if processing is performed in accordance with the data protection impact assessment at least when there is a change of the risk represented by processing operations.
sentences.9: Where necessary, the controller shall carry out a review to assess if processing is performed in accordance with the data protection impact assessment at least when there is a change of the risk represented by processing operations.
